0.name: TEXT_REGWILNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF3_00191_MOBHUNTERW1F3_000_1
0.description: You'd better be an adventurer after an elite mark, or I'll have none of you.

3.name: TEXT_REGWILNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF3_00191_A1_000_2
3.description: Tell me about the rank B elite mark. (Gatling)

4.name: TEXT_REGWILNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF3_00191_A1_000_3
4.description: Tell me about the rank A elite mark. (Maahes)

5.name: TEXT_REGWILNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF3_00191_A1_000_4
5.description: Tell me about the rank S elite mark. (Lampalagua)

7.name: TEXT_REGWILNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF3_00191_MOBHUNTERW1F3_000_10
7.description: A silly kind of thing to ask a busy man! I hunt elite marks. That's obvious enough.

8.name: TEXT_REGWILNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF3_00191_MOBHUNTERW1F3_000_11
8.description: If the gods are good and your aim is true, you shall be paid a bounty in Allied Seals.

9.name: TEXT_REGWILNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF3_00191_MOBHUNTERW1F3_000_12
9.description: I'll tell you what I know of the marks, but tarry not! We all have things to kill today.

10.name: TEXT_REGWILNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF3_00191_MOBHUNTERW1F3_000_13
10.description: My days are full of hunts, of course. Why, just yesterday I slew a rank A mark. The danger of a mark is so ranked: B, then A, and finally the dread yet elusive S.

11.name: TEXT_REGWILNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF3_00191_MOBHUNTERW1F3_000_20
11.description: “Gatling. A hedgemole of exceptionally bad temper who makes free with the lichyard of the Church of Saint Adama Landama.

12.name: TEXT_REGWILNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF3_00191_MOBHUNTERW1F3_000_21
12.description: “He has been thus dubbed for taking up residence in the tomb of Gatling the Alchemical Smith. If the creature has a true name, it remains unknown and of no great interest to local folk.”

13.name: TEXT_REGWILNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF3_00191_MOBHUNTERW1F3_000_30
13.description: “While Halatali is a cultural institution of note, it has also been less than perfect in keeping track of the fighting beasts it starves into greater savagery.

14.name: TEXT_REGWILNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF3_00191_MOBHUNTERW1F3_000_31
14.description: “Maahes is an object lesson. The blood meant for spilling on stadium sands has instead grown richer, feeding on the flesh of caravaneers.”

15.name: TEXT_REGWILNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF3_00191_MOBHUNTERW1F3_000_40
15.description: “Lampalagua. A dragon of many heads, cage-born and stadium-bred. His escape en route to the Coliseum was a major embarrassment for his handlers, or more precisely, to their heirs.

16.name: TEXT_REGWILNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF3_00191_MOBHUNTERW1F3_000_41
16.description: “Each head having been blooded as a hatchling, Lampalagua is exceptionally barbarous and exquisitely attuned to the bloodlust of the crowd.

17.name: TEXT_REGWILNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF3_00191_MOBHUNTERW1F3_000_42
17.description: “Lacking a conventional audience in the wilds of eastern Thanalan, Lampalagua has instead taken to appearing wherever violent business is afoot.”
